questions.stem: Which quadrilateral has two pairs of parallel sides and all angles equal to $90°$, but does not necessarily have all four sides equal?
questions.explanation: A rectangle has two pairs of parallel sides and all four angles are $90°$, but opposite sides are equal rather than all four sides. A square satisfies these conditions too, but also has all sides equal.

questions.stem: Which quadrilateral has all four sides equal but its angles are not necessarily $90°$?
questions.explanation: A rhombus has four equal sides. Its opposite angles are equal, but they are only $90°$ if the rhombus is also a square.
